description: Defines the GraphQLContentOptions class for configuring GraphQL content types, parts, and fields within OrchardCore, including methods for customizing content type options, hiding fields, and determining hierarchy collapsing and visibility.

classes.name: GraphQLContentOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for GraphQL content types, parts, and fields, providing methods to customize options, hide fields, and determine hierarchy behavior.

methods.name: ConfigureContentType
methods.description: Configures a content type with a specified action.

methods.name: ConfigurePart
methods.description: Configures a content part with a specified action, generic version.

methods.name: ConfigurePart
methods.description: Configures a content part with a specified action, by part name.

methods.name: IgnoreField
methods.description: Adds a field to the hidden fields list by type parameter.

methods.name: IgnoreField
methods.description: Adds a field to the hidden fields list by type and name.

methods.name: ShouldCollapse
methods.description: Determines if a content type part should be collapsed based on hierarchy and settings.

methods.name: IsCollapsedByDefault
methods.description: Checks if a content type part is collapsed by default based on options and settings.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if a content type part should be skipped based on default hiding and settings.

methods.name: IsHiddenByDefault
methods.description: Checks if a content type is hidden by default based on options.

methods.name: ShouldHide
methods.description: Determines if a content type definition should be hidden based on settings and options.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Checks if a field should be skipped based on hidden fields list.

methods.name: IsHiddenByDefault
methods.description: Checks if a content part is hidden by default based on options.

methods.name: GetFieldName
methods.description: Generates a field name, preventing collision if specified in settings.
